description: This PHP file defines the ProjectController class within the OrangeHRM Time module. The class manages project-related functionality in the HRM system, rendering a Vue.js component for project listing and handling permissions and project data retrieval via traits and external services.

classes.name: ProjectController
classes.description: Controller class responsible for managing project-related views and permissions in the OrangeHRM Time module, rendering Vue components.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares data and components before rendering, including project IDs and permission setup.
